title: The Burial of the Man of God
description: The old prophet retrieved the body of the man of God and buried him in his own tomb during a funeral ceremony. He asked his sons to place his bones beside the bones of the man of God when he died, and confirmed that the prophecy against the altar at Bethel and the high places would be fulfilled. Yet Jeroboam did not turn from his evil ways, which led to the extermination of his house.
